source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The legacy RemovePendingDBListeners loop repeats UnregisterPendingListener until it fails. Panorama DatabaseCore currently returns NS_OK without removing a pending registration. The fixed account-manager factory selection binds that service contract to DatabaseCore when the Panorama build/startup conditions hold. The virtual-folder view therefore runs the legacy drain only outside Panorama mode. Preserve this scoped consumer/return-value boundary when changing either side; a matching method name does not establish the legacy draining behavior. This is a static termination analysis, not a reproduced hang, and it does not prove the temporarily disabled hierarchy listener has been replaced.
title: The legacy virtual-folder listener drain is guarded away from Panorama no-op success
